answer: Replay-audited witness rotation needs a re-executable work log per identity, so clones cannot share a host. Newcomers lock 2,500 POA for a 21-day attestation horizon and post signed traces; seven non-adjacent witnesses replay a fresh slice before pay. Each epoch the set redraws and a 90-second comet audit names the slice to re-run; failure or copied replay slashes stake. Cost is 2,500 POA once; 1,000 fakes need 2.5M POA and 1,000 traces, vs ~180 farmable next check. A glacier archive keeps logs for six-epoch re-audits. Weakness: hired witness rings; a second draw must agree, else slash both.
